extra.final_summary: The data had three main issues: (1) 'island' column had case and space variants ('Dream ' and 'torgersen') which were normalized to 'Dream' and 'Torgersen'; (2) 'body_mass_g' was stored as text with commas (e.g., '3,150'), which was converted to numeric; (3) 'flipper_length_mm' had three negative values (-215, -228, -198) outside the valid range (170–235 mm), which were set to missing. After fixes, the total body mass by species is: Adelie: 3,667,250 grams, Chinstrap: 59,400 grams, Gentoo: 80,325 grams.
